name: The Duo - Silver
fit_note: A mini Cuban and a mini Franco chain on one clasp. Plain and bright, the purest option. The two strands sit only 2 cm apart, so it reads as one fuller chain more than two layers.

name: Layer Necklace with Coin
fit_note: Fine box chain on top, rope chain with a small hammered coin below, already spaced 5 cm apart. The cheapest way to try the look. German men's brand, on sale (was €89).

name: Necklace Set Basic (3 chains)
fit_note: Three separate chains (figaro, curb, fine Venetian). Wear the 55 cm curb with the 60 cm Venetian for a clean two-strand stack, or any one alone.
